query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM attachments a
                LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id = a.message_id
                LEFT JOIN channel_text_participants p
                    ON p.channel_id = m.channel_id AND p.user_id = $2
                LEFT JOIN dm_messages d ON d.id = a.dm_message_id
                WHERE a.id = $1
                  AND (
                    a.owner_id = $2
                    OR p.user_id IS NOT NULL
                    OR d.sender_id = $2
                    OR d.recipient_id = $2
                  )
            ) AS "exists!"
